slots.five-phase/title: Five gated phases establish the evidence before each expansion decision
slots.five-phase/timing-and-scope-qualificatio: All timing is illustrative and subject to access delays, source-data remediation, vendor constraints, and material control changes. Additional journeys, integrations, and operating hours require separate scope decisions.
slots.five-phase/delivery-phases/phase-0-activ: Mobilize before engagement: confirm sponsors, owners, data access, sample availability, security contacts, and first journey hypothesis.
Named owners and access readiness authorize discovery.
slots.five-phase/delivery-phases/phase-0-outpu: Sponsor and owner map; access readiness; first journey hypothesis.
slots.five-phase/delivery-phases/phase-1-activ: Discover and define, weeks 1–4: observe the journey, validate baseline, map system constraints, define a thin release, and agree acceptance measures.
Agree the baseline and acceptance measures before implementation.
slots.five-phase/delivery-phases/phase-1-outpu: Validated baseline; thin-release definition; acceptance checklist.
slots.five-phase/delivery-phases/phase-2-activ: Build and prove, weeks 5–10: implement the first journey, interface contract, access controls, telemetry, and test evidence in a nonproduction environment.
Use test and control evidence to assess pilot readiness.
slots.five-phase/delivery-phases/phase-2-outpu: Implemented journey; interface contract; telemetry and test evidence.
slots.five-phase/delivery-phases/phase-3-activ: Pilot and adapt, weeks 11–14: run a bounded cohort, rehearse exception handling, compare measures to validated baseline, and resolve readiness findings.
Resolve findings before a steering expansion decision.
slots.five-phase/delivery-phases/phase-3-outpu: Cohort observations; baseline comparison; owned readiness findings.
slots.five-phase/delivery-phases/phase-4-activ: Scale and transition, weeks 15–20: expand only after steering gate, transfer operational ownership, and prioritize the next journey from measured evidence.
Accept operational ownership before further expansion.
slots.five-phase/delivery-phases/phase-4-outpu: Transfer acceptance; prioritized next journey; steering decision.
slots.slide/takeaway: A five-phase sequence moves from access readiness through proof and gated transition.
